checks.name: Body ≤ 4,000 words
checks.note: The word count limitation does not include references.

checks.name: Sections match the journal's structure
checks.note: Every section marked required in the structure file must be present and non-empty

checks.name: Cover letter present
checks.note: An explanation of how the submission differs from any related preprint, dissertation or paper, any use of AI tools, and any reviewers to exclude with a brief reason.

checks.name: Conflicts summarised in the manuscript; a signed ICMJE form for every author
checks.note: Every author declares on the cover page at submission; the forms by the latest revision — one per author even with nothing to disclose.

checks.name: Conflict of interest disclosures for every author
checks.note: Complete disclosure of all relevant financial relationships; authors with none say so.
